about: The CI template's tests job: finds PHPUnit or tests/run, fails code that has neither, per language (tools/lab/ exempt), gates PHP coverage. Run: mutate-on-target.py TREE templates/ci-check.yml tests/test_ci_template.py tests/mutants/jpt-tests-job-on-template.json

mutants.name: non-PHP code with no tests/run goes green
edits:
echo "phpunit.xml covers PHP only. A test that did not run is not a pass." >&2
            exit 1

echo "phpunit.xml covers PHP only. A test that did not run is not a pass." >&2
            exit 0

mutants.name: PHP code with no entry goes green
edits:
echo "or an executable tests/run. A test that did not run is not a pass." >&2
            exit 1

echo "or an executable tests/run. A test that did not run is not a pass." >&2
            exit 0

mutants.name: phpunit.xml counted as covering every language (the mixed-repo gap)
tools/lab/ is not exempt
mutants.target: php + tools/lab scripts, phpunit only: lab is exempt

mutants.name: a docs-only repo fails for want of tests
mutants.target: no code: nothing to run, and green

mutants.name: a tests/run that is not executable is accepted
mutants.target: a tests/run that is not executable: exit

mutants.name: phpunit.xml.dist is not looked for
edits: if [ -f phpunit.xml ] || [ -f phpunit.xml.dist ]; then phpunit=yes; fi

mutants.name: the coverage threshold is fixed, not the repository's
mutants.target: coverage-gate.py gates it at the repository threshold

mutants.name: tests/run runs whether or not it was found
